newsitem.title: USA: Cytyc says pap test deemed more effective.
newsitem.headline: Cytyc says pap test deemed more effective.

text.p: Cytyc Corp said Wednesday that the Food and Drug Administration supports its claim that the ThinPrep pap test is more effective than the Pap smear method of screening women for cervical cancer.
The company said the FDA also confirmed that the quality of the cervical specimens prepared on Cytyc's ThinPrep system is significantly improved over that of the conventional Pap smear.
In May, the FDA approved the company's test as an alternative for the conventional test. The FDA reexamined all its clinical data at the company's request.

Cytyc's clinical trials showed that screening patients with its test improved detection of low-grade and more severe lesions by 65 percent and reduced the number of less than adequate specimens by more than 50 percent, it said.
The company said it expects full market introduction of the product in early 1997.
